name: smwmusic-super-mario-world-miss-resampled
title: Super Mario World - Miss (Resampled)
description:
In case a local song of yours replaces the Miss jingle's piano (@9) with a weird sample instead, you could use this instead.

This uses @1, @6, and @3, and they're smaller samples and more commonly used in SFX, so they wouldn't get omitted whatsoever.

@1 is the main instrument, @6 is used for the bass tones, and @3 is used to add an extra percussive layer for the piano.
